name: K50
kicker: Cliff waterfall in Kon Chư Răng
summary: Trek to K50, the Hang Én fall in Kon Chư Răng, and register before you go. The cliff is about 54 m, nearly 50 m, or more than 50 m. From Pleiku the reserve office is more than 140 km, then about an hour on foot, or the trail is nearly two days and nights. Skip it if you need a level path. The fee is Check on arrival.
timeNeeded: About an hour after 140 km, or nearly two days

heroCaption: K50 from the rocks at the base, with mist on the cliff

notice.title: Register before you walk
notice.body: The reserve asks you to book and sign in with the rangers. A walk that is not arranged can be turned away.

body: K50, also called Hang Én, drops inside Kon Chư Răng Nature Reserve, in Sơn Lang and Đắk Roong, Kbang. Register with the rangers before you go. The walk is a forest trek, not a roadside stop. The trail is nearly two days and nights. The reserve office is more than 140 km from Pleiku, then about an hour through the forest.

The cliff is about 54 m, nearly 50 m, or more than 50 m. The drier window is January to June, or March to June. Carry shoes with grip, water, and leech treatment. People with heart trouble, asthma, epilepsy, or blood-pressure trouble are told to skip the trek.
There is no overnight lodging at the reserve, so plan to come back the same day. The fee is Check on arrival. Hours are Check on arrival. Skip it if you wanted the lake morning in Pleiku.
